Online casino Canada FAQ
Yes, every online casino we recommend is legal for Canadian players. As part of our review criteria, we look at licences with top Canadian regulators like the Kahnawake Gaming Commission and iGaming Ontario.
Online gambling is legal in Canada, but regulated by each province. Most have government-run platforms (like OLG.ca or PlayAlberta). Ontario and Alberta also allow licensed private sites, such as bet365 and DraftKings. In other provinces, only government-approved sites are legal, though many Canadians still use offshore platforms.
